subject: Next steps & who signs off — Redwood demo follow-up
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Cloud <avery@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo follow-up — quick questions about approvals and budget

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — really appreciate you walking us through CloudMetrics' ingestion and reporting needs. Quick recap from our side: Redwood can provide a predictable inference layer for your scoring and embeddings pipelines with per-route cost controls, dedicated GPU pools if you want guaranteed throughput, and built-in audit logs for compliance.

Two quick asks so we can move the opportunity forward this week:

- Who at CloudMetrics is the economic buyer or budget owner for this type of infrastructure spend (title + name + email if possible)?
- Who should we loop in from procurement/legal for the standard security and SOC2 evidence exchange?

If you prefer, I can draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) and include proposed timelines, decision criteria, and a preliminary pricing range so Lena (or whoever signs) has a one-pager to review. I attached a draft MAP and a short SOC2 evidence checklist for your procurement team to preview.

Proposed next steps (pick any that work):
- Intro call with the budget owner (15–20m) this week
- Procurement/security sync to confirm redline cadence
- Internal technical deep-dive with Evelyn for integration specifics

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the budget owner and procurement contacts and will update the MAP based on what you share.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- CloudMetrics-MAP-v1.xlsx (attachment: MAP draft)
- SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (attachment: evidence checklist)
From: Avery Cloud <avery@cloudmetrics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — quick questions about approvals and budget

Hi Soojin — thanks for the recap and the MAP draft.

Short answers:
- Budget owner / economic buyer is likely Lena Park, VP Product (lena.park@cloudmetrics.com). She's the one who approves platform-level spend for data+inference tools.
- Procurement should be procurement@cloudmetrics.com — they handle NDAs, contracts, and billing terms.

Couple of notes from my side before we loop them in:
- Security: our InfoSec will want SOC2 and penetration test summaries. Can you confirm where Redwood hosts logs and whether audit exports can be pushed into our S3?
- Decision criteria: we're focused on sustained throughput at 200 qps for embeddings, predictable per-token spend, and SLAs for regional failover.

Can you include Connor on budget/terms conversations? I'll forward this to Lena and procurement unless you prefer to make the intro.

Thanks — happy to schedule a short sync next week.

Cheers,
Avery Cloud
Head of Data & Analytics | CloudMetrics
avery@cloudmetrics.com

Connor / Evelyn — forwarding Avery’s responses. TL;DR: Lena Park (VP Product) is the budget owner; procurement@cloudmetrics.com is the procurement address.

Action items for us:
- Connor: can you draft a short pricing band and recommended contract term (monthly vs. committed) so we have something to present to Lena? Recommend including Dedicated capacity vs. Hosted blended estimate.
- Evelyn: please prepare a short security FAQ focused on SOC2, log retention, and S3 audit export options (Avery asked specifically). If we can produce a 1-page summary + links to evidence, that will help procurement move faster.

I’ve attached the current MAP draft (v1) and the SOC2 evidence checklist from our docs. If you both can turn around small deliverables by EOD Wed, I’ll coordinate intros and propose times.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Cloud <avery@cloudmetrics.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@cloudmetrics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & next steps — MAP and proposed slots

Hi Avery, Lena, and Procurement team —

Thanks for making the intros, Avery. Lena — great to e-meet you. I’m Soojin on the Redwood account team; Connor (CC’d) will scope pricing and contract options, and Evelyn (CC’d) will handle the security evidence and integration plan.

I’ve attached the MAP (CloudMetrics-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 evidence summary (SOC2-evidence-request.pdf) for procurement’s review. High-level proposal:

1) Immediate next steps
- Procurement & security sync (30m) — propose Wed 4/15 10:00–10:30am PT or Thu 4/16 1:00–1:30pm PT — which works?
- Budget owner intro / decision criteria (20m) — propose Thurs 4/16 3:00–3:20pm PT; Connor will present pricing bands.
- Technical integration deep-dive with Evelyn (45m) — scheduled after procurement clears minimal evidence requests.

2) Decision checklist (so we align on what matters to Lena)
- Sustained throughput: 200 qps embeddings with headroom
- Cost predictability: blended per-token guidance + reserved capacity option
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence + log export capability

Please reply with preferred slots or share alternative times. If procurement prefers a DocuSign for the standard MSA or needs redlines, Connor can coordinate with legal.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- CloudMetrics-MAP-v1.xlsx (attachment: MAP with timelines & milestones)
- SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (attachment: evidence checklist)
